newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Feb EU-harmonised CPI rises 1.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Feb EU-harmonised CPI rises 1.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: The Dutch consumer price index with a weighting adapted to that of other European Union member states, rose 1.6 percent in February year-on-year, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said on Friday.

This is the first release of EU-harmonised CPI data by the CBS. Eurostat, the European Commission's statistics office, said this morning Dutch year-on-year EU-harmonised CPI had risen 1.8 percent in January. This was 0.5 percent lower than the January non-harmonised Dutch CPI released by the CBS on February 7.
Earlier today, the CBS released the non-harmonised Dutch February CPI, which was up 2.2 percent on an annual basis.
DUTCH EU-HARMONISED CPI Feb 1997 Jan 97 Feb 96
Monthly CPI pct change 0.2 n.a. n.a.
The CBS said the February 1997 figures were provisional.
The CBS has said the EU-harmonised figure would enable a better comparison of inflation rates of EU states.

The harmonised rate, which will be used to judge which EU members meet inflation criteria for European economic and monetary union (EMU), will be published alongside existing consumer price index (CPI) data from next month.
